results.title: Kai Resolve: AI Support Engineer for Hard Tickets | Gleap
results.content:
About Kai Resolve

What is Kai Resolve?

Kai Resolve is the AI support engineer for second-level (tier 2) support in Gleap. Kai Support answers customers as the first level; Kai Resolve investigates the tickets Kai Support cannot answer using the screen recording, logs and click trail captured by the Gleap SDK, account data from connected sources and your code. It answers the customer when the evidence settles the ticket, prepares a coding task for confirmed bugs and escalates open questions to your team with a diagnosis: its classification of the ticket and the evidence behind it.

What is tier 2 support, and can an AI agent do it? [...] Kai Support is first-level support: it answers customer questions from your knowledge around the clock and brings the team in when needed. Kai Resolve is second-level support: it investigates the hard tickets and answers or escalates with a diagnosis. Kai Code turns approved work into plans, code changes and pull requests your team reviews. Together they close the loop from report to shipped fix.

How is Kai Resolve different from AI support agents like Intercom Fin?

Kai Resolve is built for the tickets an answer cannot settle. It investigates: it reads the logs, the click trail and your code, states a verdict with confidence and file-level evidence, and prepares a coding task a teammate can hand to Kai Code. The escalation arrives investigated instead of as a bare handover. [...] What is tier 2 support, and can an AI agent do it?

Tier 2 (second-level) support handles the tickets first-line support cannot answer: reading logs, checking configuration, tracing bugs and involving engineering. An AI agent can take on the investigation part. Kai Resolve does it inside Gleap for SaaS and software teams: it traces the issue through the logs, the click trail and your code, answers the customer when the cause is a setting or expected behavior, and turns confirmed bugs into coding tasks. Questions that need a human decision reach your team as a card with options, so engineers see the tickets that need them with the evidence attached. Kai Support covers the first level. More in our tier 2 support guide.

results.title: Gleap Explained (2026): Kai AI Agents, Pricing and Limits
results.content:
Kai is the support agent. It answers in the customer's language across seven channels listed on the Kai page: the chat widget, email, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Slack and Telegram, all landing in one inbox.
 Kai Resolve is an investigation and routing layer. When Kai can't answer something directly, Resolve uses tools and APIs to dig into the issue and decide where it goes next: a safe operational action it can take itself, Kai Code for a development fix, Kai PM for a product decision, or a task in the human inbox.
 Kai Code is the part that turns a routed bug into an actual pull request, moving through what Gleap calls plan mode and build mode before a human reviews the change. [...] What Is Gleap and What Does Its Kai AI Cost? (2026)

Gleap is an in-app support and feedback platform for software teams, and its AI agent, Kai, answers customer questions on every Gleap plan from $49 a month billed annually, while the investigation, coding and product agents (Kai Resolve, Kai Code and Kai PM) start on the $299 Pro plan. AI usage is billed on top of every plan from prepaid credits, charged by the tokens and model used (gleap.ai/pricing, checked 24 September 2026). [...] ## Key takeaways

 Gleap's Kai AI support agent is included on every plan, starting with Starter at $49 a month billed annually or $59 billed monthly for one seat and one project.
 Kai Resolve, Kai Code and Kai PM are gated to Gleap's Pro plan, priced at $299 a month annually or $359 monthly, which also adds 25% bonus AI credits.
 Gleap bills AI usage on top of every plan from prepaid credits charged by tokens and model, and the 14-day free trial includes $25 of AI credit.
 Gleap no longer claims an 80% resolution rate for Kai; its Kai page cites Commonplace at 50-60% of inbound support and calls that their result, not a benchmark.
 Gleap's Enterprise plan starts at $999 a month annually and adds SSO and a dedicated success manager, with a HIPAA BAA depending on plan and agreement.
